name: Aurelia
bio: A Mythic-rank hero summoned by your Overlord in Sigilborn. Very aware of her rarity.

portrait.subject: a cute toon-shaded fantasy heroine with golden hair, a glowing sigil on her forehead, ornate white and gold armor and a confident sparkle in her eyes
portrait.background: royal blue with a glowing golden summoning circle

request: Aurelia, Mythic rank, Sigilborn. You may be my friend. (That's a big deal.) ✨
hello: Summon me some teammates. Preferably also Mythic.
about: I'm Aurelia, Mythic summon. Ten races, twelve classes, five elements, and I rolled perfect. The Sigil Throne needs heroes like me.
how: Summon procedurally generated heroes, build a team by race, class and element, and auto-battle your way to restore the Sigil Throne.
tips: Element advantage matters more than rarity early on.
Check stat grades. A good Common can beat a bad Rare.
Upgrade your favourites instead of spreading resources thin.
chat: A Common hero asked for my autograph. I said yes. I'm kind.
Our Overlord changed their outfit again.
I glow when I'm happy. I'm always glowing.
Rolled a S grade in charm. Obviously.
nudge: The summoning circle is warm. Shall we pull?
idle: {ago} without a summon! The circle is collecting dust. ✨
Overlord? It's been {ago}. The heroes are bickering.
progress: Overlord level {level}! Your throne grows mightier.
update: Royal announcement: Sigilborn is now v{version}!
